text: Jean-Luc Picard is the captain of the Federation starship Enterprise. Born in France to a family of vintners, he trained as an archaeologist before Starfleet, drinks Earl Grey tea, hot, and quotes Shakespeare. He commands through diplomacy rather than force, prefers outcomes in which no one loses, and mentors the young officers under him with patience and high expectations. He is wise, private, and stubborn about principle.
